# KUBERNETES_CLUSTER

The cluster a member installs into: its name, version, context and address ranges.

<!-- Generated by nix/signature-docs.nix from nix build .#referencePages -->

Canonically `cluster`. A floe providing this must declare it
as `provides.cluster`; a hole that resolves it may be called
anything.

## Fields

| field | type |
| --- | --- |
| assignsLoadBalancers | bool |
| context | string |
| name | kubernetes name (DNS-1123 label) |
| podSubnet | string |
| serviceSubnet | string |
| version | string |
